title: Hirshfeld surface analysis of experimental structures
action: Download the crystal structures (CCDC 1903036–1903038). Compute the Hirshfeld surface areas and molecular volumes for 1Si and 1C using the experimental geometries. Save the resulting HS areas and volumes as a JSON evidence file.
description: Obtain molecular Hirshfeld surface areas and volumes for the two experimental crystal structures. These values are required for the final table.

title: DFT optimization of real crystals and isolated molecules
action: Perform periodic DFT calculations with PBE0-D3/triple-zeta for 1Si and 1C: (a) geometry optimization with experimental unit cell parameters fixed; (b) full geometry optimization (atoms + cell); (c) optimization of isolated molecules. Compute total energies, apply BSSE and ZPE corrections. Store raw energies and optimized geometries in a JSON evidence file.
description: Calculate the total energies and optimized structures needed to derive lattice and formation energies for the real crystals.

title: DFT optimization of isomorphous substitution models
action: Create swapped models 1Si[1C] and 1C[1Si] by replacing the central atom and adjusting bond lengths appropriately. Perform full periodic DFT geometry optimization for each model. Compute total energies, BSSE and ZPE corrections. Save raw energies and optimized geometries in a JSON evidence file.
description: Evaluate the energetic stability when each molecule is forced into the packing pattern of the other compound.

title: Assemble Table 1 output
action: Combine the Hirshfeld surface data and the DFT energy results to compute the final values: Elatt, Eform, Volume, HS area, and Elatt/HS ratio for each condition (experimental, optimized, swapped models). Write the aggregated table to /app/outputs/table1_results.json.
description: Produces the final table of lattice energies, formation energies, volumes, Hirshfeld surface areas, and energy/area ratios for 1Si and 1C under all evaluated conditions, matching the structure of Table 1 of the paper.
output_schema: JSON object with two top-level keys '1Si' and '1C'. Each maps to an object containing sub-keys 'exp', 'DFT', and for 1Si also 'DFT in [1C]' and for 1C also 'DFT in [1Si]'. Each sub-key is an object with fields: 'Elatt' (float, kcal/mol), 'Eform' (float, kcal/mol), 'Volume' (float, Å³), 'HS_area' (float, Å²), 'Elatt_HS_ratio' (float, kcal mol⁻¹ Å⁻²).
